admin.brandingAppNameDesc: Shown on the login screen and browser tab. Leave empty to use "Termix".
admin.brandingTaglineDesc: Shown under the application name on the login screen. Leave empty to use the default tagline.
admin.brandingLogoDesc: PNG, JPEG or WEBP, up to 750 KB. Replaces the default icon on the login screen and browser tab.
admin.brandingLogoInvalid: Invalid image. Use a PNG, JPEG or WEBP file up to 750 KB.
admin.sslDescription: The certificate Termix serves over HTTPS. Upload your own here, or get and renew one from Let's Encrypt in the ACME Certificates section.
admin.sslInfoNote: After issuing or uploading a certificate, Termix will automatically enable HTTPS on SSL_PORT (default 8443) in addition to the existing HTTP port. Make sure that port is published/mapped to this container so it is reachable.
admin.sslManualDesc: Paste your existing certificate and private key, including a full chain if required by your CA.
admin.sslManualRequiresFields: Certificate and private key are required
admin.allowRegistrationDesc: Let new users self-register with a username and password
admin.externalAutoProvisionDesc: Create an account the first time someone signs in through an external login such as SSO or LDAP. When off, only people who already have an account can sign in that way
admin.secondFactorAfterExternalLogin: Ask for a second factor after external logins (SSO, GitHub, Google, LDAP)
admin.secondFactorAfterExternalLoginDesc: Off, an enrolled second factor is only asked for after password and other local logins, same as before. On, it is asked for after every login method, including SSO and LDAP.
admin.auditForwardingDesc: Ship a copy of every audit entry to an external collector as NDJSON. Local logs stay the source of truth.
admin.auditForwardingEnvNotice: An environment variable also configures forwarding; the URL saved here takes precedence.
admin.auditForwardingSaveError: Failed to save audit forwarding settings
admin.exportDatabaseDesc: Download a portable SQLite backup of all hosts, credentials, and settings
admin.importDatabaseDesc: Restore from a portable .sqlite backup on any database backend
admin.apiKeysCliHint: Use an API key with the Termix CLI to manage servers from your terminal.
admin.apiKeyCreatedWarning: Key created - copy it now, it won't be shown again.
admin.userAdminAccessDesc: Full access to all admin settings
admin.editUserDesc: Edit roles, admin status, sessions, and account settings.
admin.linkAccountDesc: Merge the external account {{username}} with an existing local account.
admin.linkAccountDescLocal: Link a local account {{username}} with an existing external-only account.
admin.linkAccountEffect2: Add its external sign-in to the target account
admin.linkAccountEffect3: Allow both external and password sign-in
admin.linkAccountTargetPlaceholder: Enter the local account username to link to
admin.linkAccountExternalPlaceholder: Enter the external-only account username to merge in
admin.linkAccountExternalNotFound: No external-only account found with that username
admin.unlinkAccountDesc: Remove external sign-in from {{username}}. They will only be able to log in with their password.
admin.unlinkAccountWarning: This will remove external sign-in from this account. The user must have a password set to keep logging in.
admin.updatePasswordLoginFailed: Failed to update password login setting
admin.updateSecondFactorAfterExternalLoginFail: Failed to update second factor setting
admin.updatePasswordResetFailed: Failed to update password reset setting
admin.sessionTimeoutRange2: Session timeout must be between 1 and 720 hours
admin.createUserPasswordTooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters
admin.dataLockedNotice: {{username}}'s data stays locked until they next log in. Their hosts, credentials and snippets cannot be viewed or edited until then.
admin.resetPasswordExternalOnly: This user signs in through an external provider and has no password.
admin.resetPasswordSuccessWiped: Password reset. The user's encrypted data was wiped.
admin.resetPasswordConfirmWipe: {{username}} has not logged in since the encryption upgrade, so their data cannot be recovered. Resetting now will delete their hosts, credentials and snippets. Continue?
admin.apiKeyCopyNotice: Copy this key now, it won't be shown again.
admin.exportUserDataDesc: Download this user's hosts, credentials and file manager data as JSON. Secrets are decrypted.
admin.deleteSuccessorLabel: Hand over hosts and credentials to
admin.deleteSuccessorDesc: Everything this user shared keeps working under the new owner; choosing nobody removes their hosts, credentials and shares.
admin.deleteUserDangerDesc: Permanently delete {{username}} and all of their data (hosts, credentials, snippets, history). This cannot be undone.
admin.deleteUserConfirm: Permanently delete {{username}} and all of their data?
admin.deleteUserAdminBlocked: Remove admin status before deleting this user.
admin.createRoleRequired: Name and display name are required

rolePermissions.loadError: Failed to load the permissions catalog

admin.notificationPrivateEndpointsDesc: Exact private hosts that notification channels may contact. Separate them with commas.
admin.updateNotificationEndpointsFailed: Failed to update notification endpoint allowlist
admin.resetSecondFactorsConfirm: Remove every second factor for {{username}}? They can sign in with their password or SSO and enrol again.
admin.passwordLoginForced: Password login is turned off, but no other login method is enabled, so it stays on for now. Nobody gets locked out.
admin.sslNotRenewed: Nothing renews this certificate. It expires {{date}}. Turn on automatic renewal in the ACME Certificates section, or upload a new one before then.
admin.sslSelfSigned: Self-signed certificate made by Termix. Browsers will warn about it.
admin.updateExternalAutoProvisionFailed: Failed to update the auto-create setting
admin.hostTagsDesc: Tags every user sees as suggestions in the host editor. Press Space or Enter to add one. Removing a tag here does not remove it from hosts.

userProfile.storageModeDescription: Browser stores settings in this browser only. Database syncs to the server and loads on any device.
userProfile.desktopProfileDescription: This profile lives on this device and signs in by itself. Link it to a Termix server to use the same hosts and settings on every device.
userProfile.interfacePresetDesc: How much detail Termix shows. Every feature stays available.
userProfile.presetConfirmDesc: This resets your sidebar, navigation, dashboard layout, terminal toolbar and file manager view. Your hosts, credentials and homepage are not touched.
userProfile.runSetupAgainDesc: Walk through the first-run setup again.
userProfile.cliDescription: Open terminals, run commands and move files from your own shell.
userProfile.deleteAccountPermanent: This action is permanent and cannot be undone.
userProfile.deleteAccountWarning: All sessions, hosts, credentials, and settings will be permanently deleted.
userProfile.keyboardShortcutsDescription: Customize terminal copy, paste, and command shortcuts
userProfile.reopenTabsOnLoginDesc: Restore your open tabs when you log in or refresh the page, even from another device
userProfile.showTabNumbersDesc: Display a number on each tab to help tell them apart
userProfile.sidebarSettingsMoved: Host sidebar display settings have moved to the Customize sidebar panel, opened from the Hosts toolbar.
userProfile.statusColorsDesc: Use green/red for online/offline status instead of the accent color
userProfile.pinAppRailDesc: Keep the left sidebar app rail always expanded instead of expanding on hover
userProfile.expandAppRailOnHoverDesc: Allow the left sidebar app rail to expand when the pointer moves over it
userProfile.appRailHoverPushesContentDesc: Make room for the expanded rail instead of opening it over the page. Open sessions, like remote desktop, resize each time
userProfile.showPinAppRailButtonDesc: Show a button in the app rail to pin it open. Off by default.
userProfile.navigationTabsDesc: Choose which tabs appear in the app rail
userProfile.createApiKeyDescription: Generate a new API key for programmatic access.
userProfile.apiKeyCreatedWarning: Key created - copy it now, it won't be shown again.
userProfile.apiKeyPermissionsHint: Keys inherit the permissions of the creating user.
userProfile.exportDataDesc: Download a backup of your hosts, credentials, and settings to transfer to another device
userProfile.importDataDesc: Restore your hosts, credentials, and settings from a .sqlite backup file
userProfile.passwordFieldsRequired: Current and new passwords are required
userProfile.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters
userProfile.deletePasswordRequired: Password is required to delete your account
userProfile.linkedProfileDescription: This device uses your account on the server and keeps a copy of your data, so it still works offline.
userProfile.onBetaDescription: Thanks for testing. Tell us what breaks.
userProfile.tryBetaDescription: Join the beta program in Updates.

developer.title: Plugin developer mode
developer.hint: Lets admins install plugins from a .tmxplug file in the Plugins tab, without the registry checks. Use it to build and test your own plugins.
developer.enableBody: Admins will be able to install plugins from files that Termix has not checked. A plugin can do anything its capabilities allow, so only turn this on while you are building or testing plugins.
developer.signedOnly: TERMIX_REQUIRE_SIGNED_PLUGINS is set, so installing from a file stays blocked.

settings.pluginSettingsInvalid: Some settings could not be saved. Check the highlighted fields.

updates.title: Updates
updates.betaIntro: Betas are early builds of the next Termix version. They come out on Tuesdays and Fridays when there is something new to try. They can have bugs, and your feedback is what makes the stable release better.
updates.termixBetasHint: Tell me about new betas, not only stable releases.
updates.runningBetaBuild: You are running a beta build. To leave, switch back to a stable image or installer.
updates.desktopInstall: Download the beta installer and install it over this one.
updates.dockerInstall: Change your image to the beta tag and restart the container:
updates.feedbackHint: Found a bug or have an idea? It goes straight to the developers with your version filled in.
updates.pluginBetasIntro: Each plugin can use betas on its own. To try one, open it and press Try beta.
updates.waitingForStable: Back on stable. Stays on {{version}} until a stable release is newer.

sync.actionFailed: That did not work. Try again.
sync.unlinkedBody: Termix works on its own on this device. Link it to your Termix server to keep everything in step.
sync.unlinkedPointHosts: Your hosts, credentials, snippets and settings follow you to every device.
sync.unlinkedPointOffline: Everything still works when the server cannot be reached, and catches up later.
sync.unlinkedPointAccount: You sign in with your server account, and hosts people shared with you show up here too.
sync.unlinked: This device is no longer linked
sync.unlinkDescription: It stops syncing and signs out of the server. Hosts shared with you by others are removed from this device either way.
sync.unlinkKeepBody: Your hosts, credentials and settings stay on this device and keep working on their own.
sync.unlinkRemoveBody: Everything that came from the server is removed from this device. Hosts kept on this device only stay.
sync.conflictsDescription: These were changed here and on the server at the same time. The server version is in use. Keep yours to send it to the server instead.
sync.errorsDescription: The server did not accept these changes. They stay on this device.
sync.errorPermission: Your account on the server is not allowed to make this change.
sync.whatSyncsDescription: Turn off anything you want to keep on this device only.
sync.notOnServer: The server does not have this
sync.localOnlyHint: You can also keep single hosts or folders on this device from their settings.
sync.originDescription: Connect to hosts from this device, or through the server. You can change this per host.

proxy.title: Reverse proxy
proxy.description: Only needed when something like Cloudflare Access or a login page sits in front of your server.

hostDefaults.descriptionAdmin: Defaults for every host on this server. A user's own defaults, a folder's defaults or the host itself can still set a different value. Change a field to set it here, or clear it to leave it unset.
hostDefaults.descriptionUser: Defaults for all of your hosts, over the server's. A folder or the host itself can still set a different value. Change a field to set it here, or clear it to leave it unset.
hostDefaults.descriptionFolder: Defaults for the hosts in this folder and its subfolders, over your own. A host can still set a different value. Change a field to set it here, or clear it to leave it unset.
hostDefaults.savedInBackground: Defaults saved. Hosts are being updated in the background.
hostDefaults.confirmNoChanges: No existing host changes. New hosts will start with these defaults.
hostDefaults.adminSectionDescription: Set the defaults every host on this server follows, for every setting a host has, including each plugin's. Users and folders can set their own on top, and any host can still use its own value.

manage.emptyHostsHint: Add a host and it shows up here, in whatever folder you give it.
manage.emptyCredentialsHint: Credentials you save can be reused by any host.
manage.hostNotFound: Couldn't find that host. Try refreshing the list.
manage.pickDefaults: Pick a level of defaults to edit
manage.pickHint: Everything about a connection lives here, grouped so you can find it.
